lines_of_business: Commercial Products only; Medicare Advantage see Related Policies
sections_in_order: Medical Criteria (TKA, Revision TKA, THA, Revision THA)
criteria_location: Medical Criteria pp.1-7; THA pp.4-6 and Replacement/Revision Hip pp.6-7. Knee criteria share the document.
procedures_covered: Total knee arthroplasty (27447) and revision knee (27486, 27487)

logic.top_level: pathways (six THA indications), each an ALL list; revision: ALL(age, any of 6) with sub-pathways

k_of_n.quote: Must have at least 2 of the following: Pain increased with initiation of activity / weight bearing / interferes with ADLs / pain with ROM
has at least 2 of the following 5 findings: Subchondral cysts, sclerosis, osteophytes, subluxation, joint space narrowing
Must have 2 of the following: Temperature > 100.4 F; Synovial WBC; ESR > 30; CRP

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Expressed as positive requirements in every pathway: no active infection, BMI < 40, tobacco 4 weeks off, HgbA1C < 8.1% or not diabetic.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Revision is a separate section (removal and replacement); no repeat limits.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Must have at least ONE of the following (Needs to meet 1 or 2): 1. Imaging shows bone-on-bone contact OR 2. There is no bone-on-bone contact, but has at least 2 of the following 5 findings ... AND must meet ALL the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The AND (conservative therapy) is attached to branch 2 only by indentation; branch 1 (bone-on-bone) may need no conservative therapy at all.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: AND ALL of the following for the above indications (1, 2, 3, 4)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Shared modifier for revision reasons 1-4 only, positioned under item 4, so scope is by label not layout.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Joint infection onset within 4 weeks of total joint replacement or new joint symptoms and findings ≤ 3 weeks
Intertrochanteric or subtrochanteric fracture and repair has failed or not feasible
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: fracture and failure conjunction vs two cases

requirement_kinds.quote: Individual is 18 years old or older
Must have at least 2 of the following: Pain increased with initiation of activity; ... weight bearing; ... interferes with ADLs; Pain with ROM
Must have BOTH of the following: Limited range of motion (ROM); Antalgic gait
Imaging shows bone-on-bone contact OR ... at least 2 of the following 5 findings
tried ALL of the following within the last year: NSAIDs or acetaminophen >3 weeks; PT or home exercise >12 weeks; Activity modification >12 weeks
Tobacco use: 4 weeks off of tobacco use prior to scheduled surgery
Diabetes control: HgbA1C < 8.1% OR not diabetic
There is stage III or IV collapse of femoral head
Acute hip fracture by imaging: comminuted or impacted acetabular; displaced femoral head or neck; intertrochanteric...
Prior authorization is recommended for Commercial Products and is obtained via the online tool

thresholds.quote: 4 weeks off of tobacco use prior to scheduled surgery
Individual is 18 years old or older

time_windows.length: 4 weeks of joint replacement; symptoms <= 3 weeks
time_windows.quote: Joint infection onset within 4 weeks of total joint replacement or new joint symptoms and findings ≤ 3 weeks

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Listed in a hip/knee block ('medically necessary ... when the medical criteria has been met'); one list for all pathways.

external_dependencies.quote: Medicare Advantage Plans National and Local Coverage Determinations
Prior Authorization of Services, Treatments or Procedures
InterQual® 2026 Procedures Adult Criteria, Total Joint Replacement, Knee and Hip

vague_terms.quote: Synovial WBC or neutrophil percentage > normal

extraction_hazards: Knee and hip criteria interleaved in one document; labels (a,b,c...) and numbering with duplicates (two 'c.' items in THA #3; a-b-d lettering in revision infection)
Bullets turn into odd glyphs (▪, o, •) with nesting indicated only by indent
Page footer in middle of lists
OCR-like duplication: '1. Subchondral cysts' numbering inside bullets
'And The individual must have tried' stray words
Revision hip infection branch has two near-identical copies
interesting_structures: Fully explicit coded structure ('meeting all of the following (a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h)')
Same comorbidity block (age, infection, BMI, tobacco, HbA1c) repeated in every pathway
Alternative paths inside a pathway: imaging bone-on-bone vs two findings plus conservative therapy
Revision infection decision tree with lab thresholds

fit_to_tree.why: Highly explicit all/any/k-of-n with numeric leaves; only scoping of ANDs by indentation and a few typos strain it.
